description: A gaunt woman in a torn, dust-coloured head covering and robe walks barefoot in the foreground, carrying a dark plastic jerrycan, across cracked, dry earth strewn with dead bare branches. Behind her, dust-shrouded figures carry containers, and low hills sit under a hazy sky. I see no letters, numbers, frame or border, and no blood or visible wounds. The era is hard to date; the jerrycan looks modern.
